# Roboflow

Build and use computer vision models fast with Roboflow. Train, deploy, and run inference on object detection, classification, and segmentation models.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/roboflow/.

## Actions

- **Get Workflow Schema** (read-only): Fetch the workflows block schema from Roboflow.
- **Run Workflow**: Run a workflow specification with provided inputs.
- **Describe Workflow Interface** (read-only): Describe the interface of a workflow specification.
- **Get Execution Engine Versions** (read-only): Retrieve available Execution Engine versions from Roboflow workflows API.
- **Get Server Info** (read-only): Retrieve information about the Roboflow inference server.
- **Get Server Metrics** (read-only): Retrieve Prometheus metrics from the Roboflow inference server.
- **Validate Workflow** (read-only): Validate a Roboflow workflow specification before execution.
